{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Americans have the right to a judicial system they can trust.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Many judges disregard the safety, values, and freedom of law-abiding citizens.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Many judges make up laws, invent new rights, free vicious criminals, and pamper felons in prison.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Many judges have arbitrarily overturned state laws enacted by citizen referenda, utterly disregarding the right of the people and the democratic process.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The sound principle of judicial review has turned into an intolerable presumption of judicial supremacy.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"A Republican Congress, working with a Republican president, will restore the separation of powers and reestablish a government of law.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Setting terms for federal judges is a way to achieve restoring the separation of powers and reestablishing a government of law.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Using Article III of the Constitution to limit appellate jurisdiction is a way to achieve restoring the separation of powers and reestablishing a government of law.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The appointing power of the presidency is the most important factor in restoring the separation of powers and reestablishing a government of law.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Governor Bush pledged to name only judges who have demonstrated that they share his conservative beliefs and respect the Constitution.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
